description: Measure the resolution an image actually achieved by Fourier ring correlation — of a TIFF stack or a photon stream — and read it against the 1/7, ½-bit or 2σ criterion.

rpc_methods.name: img_frc.resolution.compute
rpc_methods.summary: Measure image resolution by Fourier ring correlation.

filename.description: TIFF stack or photon stream to measure.

split.description: How to cut the acquisition into two independent halves: even_odd, halves, channels or two_files.

channel.description: Channel to measure, by index or name.

channel_2.description: Second channel for a channel split.

second_filename.description: Second acquisition for a two-file split.

pixel_size_nm.description: Pixel size in nm; without it the resolution is in pixels.

criterion.description: Threshold convention: fixed_1/7, half_bit or two_sigma.

bin_width.description: Ring width in cycles per pixel.

smooth.description: Rings averaged before the crossing is read.

axis_order.description: TIFF only: read a 3-D file's leading axis as auto, frames or channels.

output_path.description: Optional CSV path for the curve.

rpc_methods.name: img_frc.criteria.list
rpc_methods.summary: List the threshold criteria and the available splits.
